summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a multi-tranche offering of senior callable notes due 2030–2047. The notes include floating-rate and fixed-to-fixed reset rate series, all unsecured and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. MUFG may redeem each series in whole on a date one year prior to maturity or upon tax events. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction to raise funding and qualify as external TLAC under Japanese standards; there is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation element.
